narrative_hook: You know how to store a single piece of information, but how do you manage an entire collection, like a list of products?
title: The Digital Crate: Storing Collections of Data

narrative_hook: Now that your items are stored in a crate, you need a system to retrieve any specific one you need.
title: The Address System: Accessing List Items

narrative_hook: Your production line needs to add new items to the end of the queue as they are created.
title: Adding to the End of the Line: The 'push' Method

narrative_hook: Inspecting every item in your crate by hand is inefficient; let's build a machine to process each one automatically.
title: The Conveyor Belt: Automating Tasks with 'for' Loops

narrative_hook: What if you need the machine to run not for a fixed number of items, but until a specific condition is met?
title: Continuous Operation: The 'while' Loop

narrative_hook: To complete your assembly line, you must not only add items but also process and remove them as they are finished.
title: Project: Your First Inventory Manager
